name: brain
description: Brain - a second brain for Claude Code. Capture videos into an Obsidian knowledge graph, route every fact to one home, keep memory clean, search every past session.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: A complete second-brain workflow for Claude Code: yt-capture, vault-ingest, harvest, brain-router, dream, brain-doctor, transcript-memory (+hooks). Drop a YouTube URL, Claude transcribes and summarizes it into your Obsidian vault and grows a semantic knowledge graph. Ships with a worked starter vault (146 notes + 16 wiki pages + 614-node graph). Auto-installs yt-dlp, ffmpeg, whisper and graphify.
